subject: general
question: A right prism has a rectangular base with dimensions 6 cm and 10 cm. The height of the prism is 18 cm. Find the total surface area of the prism.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Base = rectangle → 6 × 10 = 60

Perimeter = 2(6 + 10) = 32

Lateral area = Perimeter × height = 32 × 18 = 576

Total surface area = 576 + 2 × 60 = 576 + 120

**∴ Answer = 696 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length = 10 cm, Breadth = 6 cm, Height = 18 cm

**Formula used:**

Total Surface Area = Lateral Surface Area + 2 × Base Area

Lateral Surface Area = Perimeter of base × Height

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base area = 6 × 10 = 60

⇒ Perimeter = 2(6 + 10) = 32

⇒ Lateral surface area = 32 × 18 = 576

⇒ Total surface area = 576 + 2 × 60 = 576 + 120 = 696

**∴ The correct answer is 696 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prism Surface Area

Total Surface Area = Lateral Surface Area + 2 × Base Area

Lateral Surface Area

LSA = Perimeter of base × Height

Volume of Prism

Volume = Base Area × Height

Cuboid Special Case

If base is rectangle, prism behaves like cuboid → TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl)
